name: Mumbai Winter Open 2025

venue.name: Rajwada Luxuria Villa, Yeoor Hills, Thane.
venue.address: Block No 91, House No 462, Narli Pada, Rajwada Luxuria, C/O Riyasat Bunglow, Yeoor, Vartak Nagar, Thane, Maharashtra 400606

information: This competition is being held at a rented Villa inside the perimeter of the Sanjay Gandhi National Park side in Thane (Yeoor Hills). Mumbai Winter Open 2025 is not just your ordinary WCA Cube Competition. Since this is the last competition of the year we would like to celebrate end of 2025 with all of you. The competion will have some additional perks included in your reg fee for all partciipants, 1. Complimentary Refreshments (Water, Juices, etc.) 2. Complimentary Snacks (Chips, Dips, Candy & More) The forest reserve may charge an entry fee for 4 wheelers, the fee will have to be paid to forest guards at the entry check post directly. Please carry cash, as they may not accept online payment. Participants have to carry their own puzzles (cubes). Check out all the other tabs for more information.
